comment.narrative: At least 4 disability related initiatives on local policies budget programs and services are are submitted and advocated at local authorities to better respond to the specific needs of different groups of persons with disabilities

The Action mobilised disability organisation representatives and activists in Adjara Samegrelo Shida Kartli and Kakheti regions supported their regular meetings and provided technical assistance to form RDCUs. RDCUs serve as a platforms to encourage discussions joint advocacy and experience exchange among local disability actors. Through regular discussions members of the RDCUs identified needs and challenges of the PwDs including of women IDPs and ethnic minorities and developed 4 official letters with initiatives for submission to the local governments. One initiative has been successfully advocated in Shida Kartli Gori municipality. Further efforts will be made by the FSTP recipients who are awarded with small grants to conduct policy analysis or monitoring and produce evidenced based recommendation documents that contribute to the improvement of local policies and programs. These values will be reported along with the final report of the project.
